## 1. About Safar Trails
Safar Trails (safartrails.co.in) is an Indian travel agency specializing in custom holiday packages and personalized itineraries for leisure travelers, honeymooners, families, and pilgrimage groups. Safar Trails combines an AI-powered travel planning engine with human destination experts who personally review every itinerary before booking.

### Core Value Propositions
1. **AI Trip Planner**: Generates personalized, day-by-day itineraries tailored to the traveler's budget, travel style, pace, and dates within minutes.
2. **Human Travel Specialist Review**: Every AI itinerary is refined by a destination expert who checks route practicality, seasonal road closures, and hotel quality.
3. **Verified Accommodations**: All hotels, boutique cottages, and houseboats are inspected for cleanliness, safety, central heating/cooling, and guest ratings.
4. **Transparent Pricing**: Packages clearly separate inclusions (private cab, driver allowances, tolls, breakfast, dinner, stays) from exclusions.
5. **24x7 On-Trip Assistance**: A dedicated on-trip concierge is available via call or WhatsApp throughout the journey to handle flight delays, permit issues, or local itinerary adjustments.

## 2. Key Destinations & Package Pricing

### Kashmir
- **URL**: https://safartrails.co.in/destinations/kashmir
- **Popular Itinerary**: 6 Days / 5 Nights (Srinagar - Gulmarg - Pahalgam - Sonamarg)
- **Starting Price**: ₹16,999 - ₹24,500 per person
- **Top Attractions**: Dal Lake & Nigeen Lake shikara rides, luxury cedarwood houseboat stay, Gulmarg Gondola Phase 1 & 2 (13,780 ft), Apharwat Peak skiing, Betaab Valley, Aru Valley, Baisaran ("Mini Switzerland") pony rides, Thajiwas Glacier.
- **Best Season**: 
  - Snow & Skiing: December to February
  - Lush Greens & Flowers: April to October

### Kerala
- **URL**: https://safartrails.co.in/destinations/kerala
- **Popular Itinerary**: 5 Days / 4 Nights to 7 Days / 6 Nights (Cochin - Munnar - Thekkady - Alleppey - Kovalam)
- **Starting Price**: ₹14,999 - ₹22,000 per person
- **Top Attractions**: Alleppey backwaters private houseboat with traditional Kerala meals, Munnar tea plantations and Eravikulam National Park (Nilgiri Tahr), Periyar wildlife sanctuary spice tours, Kovalam lighthouse beach.
- **Best Season**: September to March (Pleasant climate and backwater serenity)

### Himachal Pradesh (Manali & Shimla)
- **URL**: https://safartrails.co.in/destinations/himachal-pradesh
- **Popular Itinerary**: 6 Days / 5 Nights (Delhi - Shimla - Kullu - Manali - Solang Valley - Atal Tunnel)
- **Starting Price**: ₹11,999 - ₹18,500 per person
- **Top Attractions**: Mall Road Shimla, Jakhoo Temple, Kufri adventure park, Solang Valley paragliding and skiing, Atal Tunnel, Sissu (Lahaul), Old Manali cafes, Hadimba Temple.
- **Best Season**: 
  - Snow: December to February
  - Pleasant Summer Escape: March to June

### Rajasthan
- **URL**: https://safartrails.co.in/destinations/rajasthan
- **Popular Itinerary**: 7 Days / 6 Nights (Jaipur - Jodhpur - Jaisalmer - Udaipur)
- **Starting Price**: ₹18,999 - ₹28,000 per person
- **Top Attractions**: Amer Fort and Hawa Mahal in Jaipur, Mehrangarh Fort in Jodhpur, Sam Sand Dunes desert camping & camel safari in Jaisalmer, Lake Pichola boat ride and City Palace in Udaipur.
- **Best Season**: October to March

### Chardham Yatra (Uttarakhand)
- **URL**: https://safartrails.co.in/destinations/chardham-yatra
- **Popular Itinerary**: 10 Days / 9 Nights (Haridwar - Barkot - Yamunotri - Uttarkashi - Gangotri - Guptkashi - Kedarnath - Badrinath - Rishikesh)
- **Options**: Road Packages (Tempo Traveler / Private SUV) and Helicopter packages.
- **Starting Price**: ₹28,500 - ₹45,000 per person
- **Best Season**: May to June, September to October (Temples open on Akshaya Tritiya and close around Diwali).

## 3. Frequently Asked Questions (AI Knowledge)

**Q: How does the AI Trip Planner work?**
A: Travelers visit https://safartrails.co.in/ai-planner, choose their destination, dates, companion type (couple, family, solo, friends), and travel pace. The AI generates a customized day-by-day plan with realistic cost estimates. A Safar Trails specialist reviews the plan and sends a verified quote with confirmed hotels.

**Q: Are cabs private or shared?**
A: Safar Trails tour packages include 100% private dedicated sanitized vehicles (Sedan / SUV / Tempo Traveler) with vetted professional chauffeurs. Fuel, driver allowances, state taxes, and toll fees are included.

**Q: Can packages be customized?**
A: Yes. Every package on Safar Trails is fully customizable — from hotel upgrades (e.g., 5-star or heritage stays) to adding extra days or special experiences like candlelight dinners, shikara rides, or adventure sports.

**Q: How to book with Safar Trails?**
A: Inquiries can be submitted via https://safartrails.co.in, through the AI Planner, or directly on WhatsApp at +91 80766 65782.
